results.caption: Korean skin suplement haul from Olive Better 🇰🇷✨ Here’s what I picked up + what’s actually in them: • REJURAN Inner Dot DNA Glow Jelly: salmon derived PDRN/sodium DNA + low molecular weight fish collagen + hyaluronic acid + elastin. Mostly for skin hydration, elasticity and that “inner beauty” collagen angle. • Foodology Jeltiful Glutathione C Ampoule Jelly: glutathione + vitamin C + niacinamide + a moringa derived “retinol” ingredient. More of a brightening + antioxidant supplement. • Esther Formula Organic Green Curly Kale: literally 100% freeze dried organic kale powder. Basically an easy way to add concentrated greens, carotenoids and plant antioxidants. • ALL THE BETTER Lemon Ginger Shot: lemon + ginger + orange/apple concentrates plus zinc, niacinamide, biotin, vitamin D, vitamin E and B vitamins. More of a wellness / digestion / vitamin shot than a skincare supplement. Big disclaimer: supplements are not magic skincare and “popular in Korea” does not automatically mean strongly evidence based. I’m way more interested in collagen, vitamin C, zinc, omega 3s and certain probiotics than a lot of the more gimmicky inner beauty claims 👀 . #oliveyoung #glassskin #collagen #skinsupplement #glutathione
